verdict.rationale: Ashby publishes developer docs and an API reference with write and read endpoints (candidate.create, application.list with sync tokens), cursor pagination, and API-key Basic Auth. A probe confirmed the docs are live and LLM-friendly (llms.txt and markdown versions of pages). Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found at the common paths, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use HTTP Basic Auth to authenticate with our API. You must send your API key with every request.
Some endpoints are paginated, and, optionally take an opaque "cursor" to indicate the page of results to fetch.
A sync token to retrieve only applications updated since the last sync.
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
